title: Keep devices online during deployment and stagger automatic updates across large fleets.
changes: Defer new agent updates throughout backend HA rollout and a bounded 10-minute post-deploy stabilization window, without blocking a subsequent deployment.
Spread each new automatic client/runtime upgrade across a deterministic 24-hour per-device release window, with a shared Redis epoch and server time to withstand reconnects and clock skew.
Distribute automatic version checks across per-device 30-minute cycles rather than creating a reconnect-triggered request storm.
Admit at most 120 legacy automatic update hints per minute across backend replicas, while leaving manual updates and urgent runtime repairs available.
Package the fleet scheduler and its regression tests with the public client, preserving exact-release source and npm-artifact parity.
